name: HKD At Par
notes: Anchorpoint states HKDAP is an HKMA-licensed HKD-backed stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 for HKD, with Beta Access institutional rollout beginning 2026-08-12 and reserves held in a legally segregated trust structure. Full-layer promotion remains gated on CI and canonical baseline synchronization.

name: MGUSD
notes: MoneyGram officially launched MGUSD on 2026-06-02 as a native U.S.-dollar stablecoin on Stellar. MoneyGram identifies Bridge, a Stripe company, as the regulated issuer, with M0 mint/burn infrastructure and Fireblocks wallet infrastructure. Full-layer promotion remains gated on repository duplicate validation, reserve/redemption normalization and CI.
